regime_context: China A-shares detector shows a narrow, two-horse leadership: Banks (rank 1, eligible, crowded, durability 0.73) and Innovative Pharma & CXO (rank 2, eligible, crowded, durability 0.60) sit far above the rest, while breadth of rotation is just 18% and the absolute-trend gate did not hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false). Momentum rank here is a focus lens, not alpha, and past directional accuracy is weak (0.377).
emerging_watch: Watch Industrial Metals (cn_metals, rank 5, ineligible) and Coal (cn_coal, rank 6, eligible): both sit in the mid-rank cyclicals band with trend-tagged durability near 0.26-0.46. The condition that retires this watch is either theme climbing into the eligible top-3 with a durability bar above 0.45, or both falling out of the top 10 entirely.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the headline leader with the strongest composite state: rank 1, eligible under the trend gate, highest durability (0.73), and broad participation (breadth 0.889). This is the dominant theme — the lean is a continuation read on the prevailing narrative, not a momentum-return claim. Crowding (z=1.78, crowded=true) is a size-down caution only, not a fade trigger.
evidence: crowding_z 1.78 flags crowded — cap, do not fade
theses.dissent: Banks are crowded and the absolute-trend gate has no validated drawdown-reduction edge on this mean-reverting A-share tape (gate_helps=false), so the trend discipline that nominally supports the overweight has failed historically here.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags the CSI 300 by 5% between now and 2026-10-20

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is the only other eligible, high-rank theme (rank 2, score 0.988) with a legitimate durability bar (0.60) — the rotation margin to Banks is razor-thin (0.01) and breadth of rotation is narrow, so this is a two-leader tape, not a clean single narrative. A modest lean alongside Banks reflects the near-tie at the top.
theses.dissent: Crowded alongside Banks, and its breadth (0.643) is materially thinner than Banks' 0.889, suggesting weaker internal participation that could leave it more vulnerable in a shake-out.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors is eligible (trend gate passes) but ranks 8th with a low score (0.315) and very thin breadth (0.091). The only reason it carries any lean is eligibility — but momentum rank is a focus lens, not a return edge, and there is no rotation signal favoring it. An underweight expresses absence of leadership rather than a directional short.
evidence: durability_bar 0.54 but low score — mixed signal
theses.dissent: Semis sit in the AI/tech narrative zone that macro headlines are touching (ai_tech appears in macro_narrative), and eligibility means the trend gate did not stop it out — it could catch a re-rating bid if the one-narrative structure breaks.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
